purpose: Replace weak or over-broad evidence in lots 4, 6 and 8, and record two inherited decisions confirmed by direct reading of current official airline pages.

provenance_defaults.reviewer: Codex — direct reading of official airline page

replace_facts.condition_scope: Live-animal cargo is accepted only subject to reservation confirmation, animal, aircraft, temperature, route, documentation and THAI Cargo conditions.
replace_facts.finder_effect: Thai Airways cargo is a documented conditional route, never guaranteed acceptance for a specific flight.
replace_facts.quote: The acceptance of live - animal consignments is subject to the conditions described in the IATA's Live Animals Regulations and to TG's Regulations

replace_facts.condition_scope: Pets may be checked only after prior approval by China Southern and successive carriers, with quarantine, vaccination, route, document and container requirements.
replace_facts.finder_effect: China Southern hold is a documented conditional route.
replace_facts.quote: Sorry, a pet can not be taken into cabin. However, you can check it.
replace_facts.locator: Pets → May I take my pet into cabin?

replace_facts.condition_scope: The official IndiGo CarGo FAQ directly refuses transportation of a pet dog as cargo.
replace_facts.finder_effect: IndiGo cargo is a documented refusal for pet dogs.
replace_facts.quote: No, IndiGo does not carry livestock
replace_facts.locator: Product Guidelines → Need help? Check FAQs → Can I transport my pet dog on CarGo?

replace_facts.condition_scope: Live dogs and cats are accepted as special cargo on Airbus and ATR72 on domestic routes except Bangkok–Krabi v.v. and Chiang Mai–Krabi v.v.; all international stations are excluded; booking, certificate, kennel, breed and capacity conditions apply.
replace_facts.finder_effect: Offer Bangkok Airways cargo only within the explicitly supported domestic scope; do not offer it on international routes or the two excluded domestic route pairs.
replace_facts.quote: Special cargo service as Live animals dog, cat (AVI) is available on Airbus and ATR72 on the following routes:
replace_facts.locator: Cargo Service → Pet Carriage Service → Domestic Routes / International Routes

replace_facts.condition_scope: Pet-agent booking and operating-airline, aircraft and route restrictions apply; Aer Lingus Regional operated by Emerald Airlines prohibits pet carriage, and some aircraft holds are not ventilated.
replace_facts.finder_effect: Aer Lingus hold is a conditional route; do not present it for every Aer Lingus-marketed itinerary.
replace_facts.quote: Pets must be booked to travel with a pet agent, and they will be carried in the aircraft hold.
replace_facts.locator: Baggage Information → General Animals & Pets Rules

replace_facts.condition_scope: Pet dogs and cats on flights operated by Air China, subject to advance booking, quota, age, breed, route, documentation and under-seat carrier restrictions.
replace_facts.finder_effect: Air China cabin is a documented conditional route on Air China-operated flights; do not extend it to partner-operated flights or treat it as guaranteed availability.
replace_facts.quote: A maximum of 2 pets are permitted per flight, and each passenger may bring no more than 1 pet into the cabin.
replace_facts.locator: Agreement for In-Cabin Transportation of Pets → I. Carrier's Regulations on Pet Transportation

threshold_rule.general_rule: A threshold may eliminate a channel but never establish positive acceptance or availability by itself.
